proposal_note: These three proposed rows follow the public split-light-verb case shape in #457. They have not received formal data adoption or engine measurement.

related_adopted_data.relation: The adopted rows establish the joint-action statement and question contrast. These new rows use 作業 as a split light verb.

semantic_checks: みんなで marks the group that performs the shared 作業 action.
ます。 states the action as an ordinary polite statement, not an invitation.
The Taiwanese Chinese translation keeps the group and shared action without adding a time or place.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not identify the members of the group or the person speaking.
The source gives no time or location.

stable: The shared action is 作業します in all three rows.
changed: This row uses みんなで for the joint actor and ends with ます。 for a statement.
limits: The source does not specify who the group includes.

items.jp: みんなで作業しますか。
semantic_checks: みんなで marks the group that performs the shared 作業 action.
ますか。 asks an ordinary information question about the action; it is not a proposal.
The question keeps the affirmative proposition that the group performs 作業 together.
semantic_unknowns: Context can affect whether this short question sounds invitational.
The source does not identify the group members, the addressee, or the time.

stable: The shared action is 作業します in all three rows.
changed: This row uses みんなで for the joint actor and ends with ますか。 for an information question.
limits: The Taiwanese Chinese question should not add a proposal or invitation.

items.jp: 図書館で作業しますか。
semantic_checks: で marks 図書館 as the location of 作業.
ますか。 asks an ordinary information question.
This control does not name a group or add a joint actor.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not identify who works or the time.

stable: The action and polite information-question ending match PLJV-N5-02.
changed: This row uses 図書館で for a location instead of みんなで for a joint actor.
limits: Do not infer participants or group action from the location marker.
